snippet.title: Sonic 1 Co-op Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the same trailer that has been showcased off Sonic Hacking Spotlight!

Release date for the rom hack will be at SHC24!

Update 1:
The Rom Hack has been delayed to November 21 this year.

Update 2: 
The Rom Hack has been delayed to SHC25 to further improve the quality of the hack, and include some neat features and mechanics!
